brief: A wall-hung spice rack: at least three bins, hung from keyhole hangers.

requirements.evidence: Three full bins at cells (0,0), (1,0) and (2,0), each on a base piece.

Only one keyhole hanger is fitted, on cell (2,0) slot 0. A second on cell (0,0) was refused because an edge cap sits on that flat. I did not check that this flat is the wall-facing side, and I did not look at the result from behind.
This is a 3-cell row of bins with end caps and joint bolts. The check_build run reports meshClash clear. One hanger at the end of a row may not hold the row level on the wall. I added no spice props.

finish.summary: I built a row of three bins on three base pieces, with open faces capped and joints bolted. It has one keyhole hanger, on the end cell. The brief says "hangers", so this is a compromise. Check which face the hanger is on before you mount it, and consider adding a second hanger."

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
